Gujarat High Court upholds death penalty for 38 in 2008 Ahmedabad blasts

The Gujarat High Court has upheld the death sentence for 38 individuals convicted in the 2008 Ahmedabad serial blasts case. The court also confirmed life imprisonment for 11 other convicts. These blasts, which occurred on July 26, 2008, resulted in 56 deaths and injured over 200 people. The High Court's decision affirms a special court's earlier verdict.
